cases.rationale: A live giraffe with its long patterned neck and body and a live zebra with a striped body, head and legs stand in an outdoor rocky enclosure. The zebra is identifiable as zebra rather than horse; the giraffe is an animal rather than a representation. Trees and rocks do not provide potted-plant or furniture evidence. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A person in shorts and athletic shoes is airborne above an actual skateboard. The curved deck and wheel hardware identify skateboard rather than snowboard or surfboard. The graphic on the underside is printed imagery and does not establish actual objects depicted by it. The surrounding floor, walls and ledge contain no other identifiable category objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Several actual people are visible, and the central white-shirted person wears a red necktie. The lower-right YAMAHA instrument is a musical keyboard, excluded from computer keyboard. A partly cropped wooden seating frame behind it is insufficient to distinguish chair from bench, so both remain unclear. Small partly occluded bags on the rear ledge lack enough design detail to distinguish backpack from handbag/tote, leaving both unclear. A small green neck-like form behind the balloons at upper left might be a bottle but its body is obscured, so bottle is unclear. The white rear surface is a ledge rather than an identifiable dining table. All 75 definitions were considered.

Helmeted human riders and actual motorcycles fill this street crop; the motor-driven bodies and rear storage units distinguish them from bicycles. Tiny distant vehicle forms along the left street cannot be confidently identified as passenger cars, so car is unclear. A small dark vertical street fixture in the distant intersection could be a signal head but lacks clear lamp detail, so traffic light is unclear. Orange cones, signs and lamp poles alone do not establish other traffic categories. All 75 definitions were considered.

The crop shows a bed with mattress, pillows and rumpled pale bedding, an actual standalone television on a cabinet at upper left, and a wooden single-person chair with a slatted back near the window. The bed reflected at upper right does not add another category, and the loose bedding is supported by clear bed context. The television cabinet and window ledges are not dining tables. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A cropped red fire hydrant at the right edge has an identifiable upright hydrant body and projecting capped outlet. The rest of the crop is grass with small fallen leaves; this is not evidence for potted plant or food. No animal or human is visible. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A tennis player on the near court holds an identifiable racket beside the legs; numerous other actual people occupy the court and stands. Rows of individual blue stadium seats establish actual chairs. The pale curved shape at the lower-left spectator edge does not show an umbrella canopy or shaft. Signs and court equipment do not establish electronic displays or other sports-object categories. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Whole pale apples with stem depressions and orange citrus fruits are arranged along the top. The tied central bundle has identifiable tapered orange carrot roots and green tops. Leafy greens, leeks, radishes and brown roots are not banana or other listed foods. Green material inside the crinkled bag at right may include broccoli but the floret structure is insufficiently resolved, leaving broccoli unclear. The flat display surface lacks identifiable dining-table context. All 75 definitions were considered.

Actual pedestrians stand and walk at a street corner. A red octagonal STOP face identifies a stop sign. Passenger cars are partly visible along the far-right street edge. The pedestrian crossing in the white shirt and dark cap wears a dark backpack with a pack body against the back and shoulder straps. The central man wears suspenders rather than a tie, and his printed display board is neither a bound book nor the actual items pictured or named on it. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual person leans on a bed with pillows and a patterned bedspread while reading an open bound book with joined pages. The shelf behind holds an identifiable beige time-of-day clock with a circular dial. The shelf and headboard are not bench or chair evidence, and floral wallpaper is excluded from actual plant presence. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Two actual human tennis players stand with visible oval strung tennis rackets and handles. The central wheeled apparatus is court equipment rather than a vehicle, suitcase or appliance in the frozen definitions. Its cylinders and handles do not show bottle, cup or remote identity. The worn wristbands and headwear are not neckties. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Several rigid travel suitcases with luggage shells, handles and wheels surround a bed at left. A thin black wall-mounted television is partly cropped at upper right. Bare decorative branches stand in an identifiable rounded vase behind the large rear suitcase, rather than a growing potted plant. Scattered paper publications on the floor may include a bound book, but book versus magazine/newspaper cannot be determined, so book remains unclear. The black device and paper trays on the bed are not identifiable laptop or computer keyboard. All 75 definitions were considered.
